FAQ: What if my camera isn’t listed?
Please submit a camera request to suggest adding your camera model.
Are all features (like tethering and live view) supported for every camera?
No. Feature support (e.g. tethering, live view, wireless) varies by model and is listed alongside each camera entry.
What RAW file formats are supported?

Capture One supports various proprietary RAW formats including CR2, CR3 (Canon), NEF (Nikon), ARW (Sony), RAF (Fujifilm), and more. The support for cameras is not tied to a specific file format, but is done per camera model basis. Note that only 8-bit HEIC files are supported (most of the new cameras shoot in 10-bit HEIC format and higher).
My new camera is not supported in my old version. What do I do?

The support for new cameras comes with the new versions only, so if you need to edit files from that camera, you need to upgrade your version of Capture One. See more details about pricing and the cost of the upgrade here: New License Model: Changes to the way licensing, updates, and upgrades work
